item.title: Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition Switch 2 Version Announced, and It's Out Now
item.description: Xenoblade Chronicles X: Definitive Edition is coming to Switch 2, and by "is coming", we mean "has come", because it's available right now! Read this article on TechRaptor

item.title: Free League's Latest Dragonbane Trudvang Kickstarter Slays Funding Goal in Minutes

item.title: Bloodlines 2's The Chinese Room Teams Up With Lyrical Games for Next Project
item.description: The Chinese Room, the studio (eventually) responsible for Vampire: The Masquerade - Bloodlines 2, has teamed up with Valor Mortis publisher Lyrical Games for its next project. Read this article on TechRaptor

item.title: Donutal Is a Papers Please-Style "Alien Screening" Game from Arc System Works
item.description: Legendary fighting game studio Arc System Works has announced Donutal, an "alien screening adventure" in which the characters you deal with are very definitely not a human. Read this article on TechRaptor

item.title: Splinter Cell Remake Dev Ubisoft Toronto Hit by Layoffs
item.description: Ubisoft has apparently laid off yet more employees, and this time, it's the studio's Toronto division that's been hit. Read this article on TechRaptor

item.title: Sony Shutting Down Bluepoint Games In March
item.description: Sony shocked the gaming industry today announcing the closure of remake specialists Bluepoint Games with the developers being laid off. Read this article on TechRaptor

item.title: Critical Role and Titmouse Announces New Actual Play, Draw Your Weapons

item.title: Rainbow Billy: The Book of Fears Wants You to Investigate a Weird Summer Camp
